title: D-045 A1 wave 1: R1+R2 series height/setback draft rule families (numeric-limit districts, R5-pilot discipline)

risks: SOURCE AVAILABILITY: if a needed official ZR section snapshot is absent from the corpus and cannot be captured through the established snapshot mechanism from the producer sandbox, submit BLOCKED naming the exact sections - NEVER transcribe from memory or a secondary source (permanent principle 3)

the R1/R2 series may carry conditional provisions that reference geometry-dependent mechanics (A2 territory) - such provisions are recorded as typed fail-closed gaps citing the section, NOT implemented in this wave (D-045-R008 sequencing)
cross-variant leakage is the family's chief modeling hazard (R2A/R2X contextual-style caps differ from R2) - per-variant scoping with isolation tests is mandatory, no shared defaults
Python 3.12 repo vs 3.11 sandbox (M2-T015 pattern): if pytest cannot collect locally, rely on CI evidence and disclose
amendment currency: the extraction must state WHICH text version each snapshot captures and its effective date; a superseded value with a newer amendment in force is a defect
